work_package_subject: Select independent bridge-deck concrete testing laboratory
requirements: active accreditation covering ASTM C39 high-strength concrete at 80 MPa or greater

scoring_rule: Award one point for each requirement, but selection requires all three points and no mandatory failure.

database_rule: Qualification data is read-only; do not alter evidence to make a laboratory qualify.
